subject: DJURÖ 4:147 (Djurö byväg 34)

method.solar_position: NOAA/Meeus low-precision solar position algorithm (deterministic astronomy, self-checked: equinox sunrise/sunset ~90/270 deg, solstice noon altitude = 90 - lat + 23.44 deg exactly)
method.irradiation: PVGIS v5.2 PVcalc API (JRC, EU Commission), PVGIS-SARAH2 radiation DB, ERA5 meteo, DEM-calculated horizon, free-standing 0deg tilt reference surface
method.cross_reference: sunrise/sunset azimuths cross-checked against the DEM viewshed sea-view arcs in terrain-dem-derived-v0.1.json

summary.note: Summer solstice sunrise (az ~40 deg NE) falls inside the DEM-derived sea-view arc (NW 321 -> ESE 114 through N/NE/E) -> morning sun rises over open water. Summer sunset (az ~322 deg NW) sits at the edge of that arc. Winter and equinox sunrise/sunset azimuths (SE/SW, E/W) fall mostly outside the sea-view arc -> afternoon/evening sun is land-facing, consistent with the WNW ground-slope aspect (see terrain-dem-derived-v0.1.json).
summary.class: DERIVED — both the astronomy and the water/viewshed classification it is cross-checked against are derived, not surveyed.

not_checked: actual shading from trees/neighbouring structures at sunrise/sunset (viewshed does not model vegetation or building height); does not account for the 2026 calendar leap/adjustment beyond standard Julian-day math
